title: Short-term arrival strategies for endurance exercise performance at moderate altitude
claims: The study compared 14 hours of overnight hypoxic exposure with 2 hours of hypoxic exposure before a 20-km cycling time trial at a simulated 2500 m.
Performance responses diverged between the 14-hour and 2-hour conditions but were not explained by the measured physiological variables.
Athletes restricted to arriving the evening before competition would not gain a clear advantage by delaying arrival to a few hours before the event.
The paper notes that 5-7 days of acclimatisation produced worse performance than 14-19 days, while residence longer than 19 days produced only marginal additional gains.

verification.note: 出版社页面可读全文；核对 10 名受试者、三次实验条件、20 km 计时赛与引言中 14–19 天适应期表述。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“10 cyclists completed overnight laboratory exposures of: 1) a 14-h exposure to normobaric hypoxia (16.2% O2, simulating 2,500 m; 14H), 2) a 12-h exposure to normoxia, then a 2-h hypoxic exposure (2H) ... Immediately following each exposure, subjects completed a 20-km cycle ergometry time trial ... in 16.2% O2 (14H and 2H).”
原文：“Although some divergent 20-km performance responses were observed between 14H and 2H, they were not explained by the physiological measures completed.”

原文：“endurance athletes who are logistically restricted from arriving at altitude more than the evening before competition would not gain an advantage by delaying their arrival until a few hours before the competition.”

原文引言：“performance was impaired to a greater degree after 5–7 days of acclimatization compared with 14–19 days of acclimatization, and altitude residence longer than 19 days produced only marginal additional performance gains”；该句引述他人研究，claim 用“The paper notes”是准确的。
